migration.title: BLFX Migration Required
migration.contentPhrase1: An important update is available that requires migrating your item animations to the latest version.
migration.contentPhrase2: This migration will update your item animations to be compatible with new features and improvements.
migration.contentPhrase4: {boldStart}Note{boldEnd}: This process will overwrite any customizations made directly to the macros, so always remember to {boldStart}back up your data{boldEnd}.
migration.errorMessage1: An error occurred during migration. Please check the console for details.

transfer.title: BLFX Transfer Animations
transfer.contentPhrase1: {boldStart}Free to Premium.{boldEnd} Transfer your custom animations from the Free version to the Premium version!
transfer.contentPhrase2: After transfer, consider using {boldStart}Migrate Items{boldEnd} to enhance your animations with the latest features, like sound.
transfer.contentPhrase3: {boldStart}DnD v3 to DnD v4.{boldEnd} Transfer animations from DnD5e v3 to DnD5e v4. Note that this process is best effort and it will work only for items that have one animation and one activity!
transfer.contentPhrase4: Animations from all tokens in all scenes and all items in the Items sidebar will be included in the process.
transfer.button2Label: Transfer Animations (DnD5e v3 to DnD5e v4)
transfer.uiNotification1: There are no animations to transfer!
transfer.uiNotification2: MidiQoL is not active, nothing to transfer!
transfer.uiNotification3: This option can be used only for D&D5e-v4, nothing to transfer!
